| -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `FOR UPDATE`                                                               | yes (`Locking: true`)                                                                                                                                  | SQLite: `ErrUnsupported`; MySQL and MariaDB: yes (`NOWAIT`, `SKIP LOCKED`; `FOR SHARE` renders as `LOCK IN SHARE MODE` on MariaDB)                                                                                                                                                                        | `ForUpdate()`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `FOR UPDATE NOWAIT` / `SKIP LOCKED`                                        | yes                                                                                                                                                    | same                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `ForUpdate("NOWAIT")`, `ForUpdate("SKIP LOCKED")`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `FOR SHARE`                                                                | yes                                                                                                                                                    | same                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `ForShare()`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| `FOR NO KEY UPDATE` / `FOR KEY SHARE`                                      | yes, with `NOWAIT`, `SKIP LOCKED` and `OF`                                                                                                             | SQLite and MySQL: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `ForNoKeyUpdate()`, `ForKeyShare()`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `FOR UPDATE OF <table>`                                                    | yes; names are quoted aliases or table names                                                                                                           | SQLite: `ErrUnsupported`; MySQL: yes; MariaDB: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | `ForUpdate("SKIP LOCKED").LockOf("d", "t")`; without a lock mode, an unknown or CTE name, `NOWAIT` together with `SKIP LOCKED`, or DISTINCT, GROUP BY or HAVING: `ErrValidation`; `Count` and `Exists` keep the lock clause                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Advisory transaction locks                                                 | yes: `pg_advisory_xact_lock`, `pg_try_advisory_xact_lock`, text keys through `hashtext`                                                                | `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `advisory.XactLock`, `advisory.XactLockString`, `advisory.TryXactLock`, `advisory.TryXactLockString` (package `github.com/azrtydxb/momo/advisory`, taking the `*Tx`); a `DB` does not compile, because a transaction lock outside a transaction is meaningless. String and int64 keys share one bigint key space, and `hashtext` is not stable across PostgreSQL major versions, so never store a hashed key                                                                                                                                                     |
| Advisory session locks                                                     | yes: `pg_advisory_lock`, `pg_try_advisory_lock`, `pg_advisory_unlock` on a pinned connection (`db.OnConn`); 64-bit text keys through `advisory.Hash64` | `ErrUnsupported`; a pooled `*DB` is `ErrValidation`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `advisory.Lock`, `advisory.TryLock`, `advisory.Unlock` and the string forms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| CTE                                                                        | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite and MySQL: yes, covered by the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `SelectQuery.With(name, subquery, cols...)`; `CTE(name)` as table source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Recursive CTE                                                              | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite and MySQL: yes, covered by the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `WithRecursive(...)`; `Union(all, qs...)` builds the body                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Subqueries                                                                 | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite and MySQL: yes, covered by the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `Exists`, `NotExists`, `FromSubquery(q, alias)`, `IN` subquery, `RawSubquery`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Select-list alias                                                          | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite yes; MySQL runs in the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`) only where that suite covers it                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `momo.As` and `.As` on aggregates and expressions name the item; `Aliased.Ref(source)` reads that name from a subquery or CTE                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Typed `substr`, `CASE`, arithmetic                                         | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite yes; MySQL runs in the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`) only where that suite covers it                                                                                                                                                                                                               | `momo.Func[T]`; in `sqlfn`: `sqlfn.Substr`, `sqlfn.Lower`, `sqlfn.Upper`, `sqlfn.Length` (MySQL: `char_length`), `sqlfn.Case[T]()`, `sqlfn.Add`/`sqlfn.Sub`/`sqlfn.Mul` and `...Expr`, `sqlfn.CoalesceExpr`, `sqlfn.Cast[T]`, `sqlfn.Concat`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Aggregate ORDER BY, `WITHIN GROUP`, `string_agg`, `array_agg`, `jsonb_agg` | yes                                                                                                                                                    | `agg.String` yes (SQLite 3.44+ for ORDER BY; MySQL `GROUP_CONCAT ... SEPARATOR`); `agg.JSONB`/`agg.BuildObject` map to `json_group_array`/`json_object` and `JSON_ARRAYAGG`/`JSON_OBJECT` (no ORDER BY on MySQL); `agg.Array`, `WithinGroup`, `agg.PercentileCont`/`agg.PercentileDisc`: `ErrUnsupported` | `agg.Func[T]`, `.OrderBy`, `.WithinGroup`, `.Filter`, `agg.String`, `agg.Array[T]`, `agg.JSONB[T]`, `agg.BuildObject[T]`, `agg.Field`, `agg.ToJSONB[T]`, `agg.EmptyJSONArray[T]`, `agg.PercentileCont`, `agg.PercentileDisc[T]`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `current_schema()`                                                         | yes                                                                                                                                                    | MySQL maps to `DATABASE()`; SQLite `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `sqlfn.CurrentSchema()`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| Raw fragment composition                                                   | yes                                                                                                                                                    | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `JoinSQL`, `JoinTypedSQL`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Window functions                                                           | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite: yes; MySQL: runs in the shared suite (`suite.RunAll`) only where that suite covers it                                                                                                                                                                                                             | `Over` builds the window: `PartitionBy`, `OrderBy`, frame methods `Rows`, `Range`, `Groups` with `UnboundedPreceding`, `Preceding`, `CurrentRow`, `Following`, `UnboundedFollowing`. Attach it with `Agg.Over`, `agg.Call.Over` (not with an inner ORDER BY or WITHIN GROUP) or `RowNumber`, `Rank`, `DenseRank`, `Lag`, `Lead`, `FirstValue`, `LastValue` followed by `.Over`. A missing ORDER BY on a ranking or offset function, a frame on a ranking function and a malformed frame fail with `ErrValidation`; `Groups` on MySQL fails with `ErrUnsupported` |
| Aggregate `FILTER` clause                                                  | yes                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite: yes; MySQL: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | `Agg.Filter` returns a `FilteredAgg` usable in a select list, HAVING and `Over`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| `DISTINCT ON`                                                              | yes                                                                                                                                                    | `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `SelectQuery.DistinctOn`; the leading ORDER BY items must be the DISTINCT ON expressions in any order, and an OrderBy is required, otherwise `ErrValidation` at build time                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Set-returning FROM sources                                                 | yes                                                                                                                                                    | `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `Unnest` over bound arrays built with `UnnestValues` or `UnnestValuesAs` (one column each, optional `WithOrdinality`); `GenerateSeries` over integers and `GenerateTimeSeries` over timestamps. They work as FROM, as Join and inside a CTE body                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `LATERAL` joins                                                            | yes                                                                                                                                                    | MySQL 8: yes; SQLite and MariaDB: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        | `Lateral` wraps a subquery as a Join, LeftJoin (with `SQL` true as the ON condition) or CrossJoin source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Window functions used internally                                           | yes: row numbering over partitions                                                                                                                     | SQLite: yes, covered by the integration tests that run on SQLite; MySQL: not covered by a MySQL integration test yet                                                                                                                                                                                      | `LoadPerParentLimit` only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |

JSON operators: keys and values are bound, except that a plain key (letters, digits, underscore) in `jsonop.Text` and `jsonop.Path` is inlined so a grouped extraction works (never on a sensitive column, whose keys stay bound and masked). An extraction is NULL for a missing key and for JSON null, while a SQL NULL column and the JSON literal null stay distinct on the column itself; see the `jsonop` package documentation.

## Relations

The table describes PostgreSQL behavior; the shared integration tests also run
relation loading on SQLite (`testopen.Each`). Behavior and error table:
[relations.md](relations.md).

| Feature                              | PostgreSQL                                                                                                                                                                                    | API                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Kinds                                | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `belongs_to`, `has_one`, `has_many`, `many2many` (tag `rel:`); polymorphic through `Discriminator`                |
| Foreign keys on composite-PK columns | yes: `belongs_to` with `fk:` naming a column inside the referencing model's composite primary key                                                                                             | `momo:"belongs_to,fk:LicenseID"`; the target needs a single-column primary key                                    |
| Load one or several                  | yes; one statement per relation per bind-limit chunk                                                                                                                                          | `Load`, `LoadAll`                                                                                                 |
| Load through a query                 | yes for `All`, `One`, `First`                                                                                                                                                                 | `SelectQuery.Preload(...)`                                                                                        |
| Load options                         | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `Relation.Scope(...)` with `LoadWhere`, `LoadOrderBy`, `LoadPerParentLimit`, `LoadWithDeleted`, `LoadOnlyDeleted` |
| Top-N per parent                     | has-many and many-to-many; belongs-to and has-one: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                           | `LoadPerParentLimit(n)`                                                                                           |
| Nested loads                         | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `Relation.Then(...)`                                                                                              |
| Single-query load                    | belongs-to with a unique child key only; others `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                              | `Relation.Joined()` passed to `Preload` (LEFT JOIN)                                                               |
| Pipelined loading                    | yes, automatic when the driver is a `Batcher` (pgx pool, transaction, pinned connection); sequential on other drivers such as `FromSQLDB`, and when the driver rejects the batch (Op "batch") | nothing to configure                                                                                              |
| Predicates                           | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `Has`, `HasFrom`, `HasNo`, `CountOrder`                                                                           |
| Traversal                            | yes; many-to-many: `ErrValidation`                                                                                                                                                            | `Relation.From(parentQuery)`                                                                                      |
| Association helpers                  | yes; belongs-to: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                                                                                             | `Link`, `Unlink`, `Replace`, `Count`                                                                              |
| Graph writes                         | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `Include` with `CreateGraph`, `FindOrCreate`, `UpsertByPK`                                                        |
| Hooks                                | yes                                                                                                                                                                                           | `RelationHook`, `RelationEvent`                                                                                   |

## Vectors

PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension, SQLite through sqlite-vec
(`driver/sqlitedriver`), MariaDB 11.8 (float32 vectors,
Euclidean and cosine distance, `VECTOR INDEX`) and MySQL 9.x (storage only,
distance is `ErrUnsupported`). The MySQL column in the table below
covers MySQL only; for MariaDB see
[vectors.md](vectors.md#mariadb-and-mysql).

| Feature                                                                | PostgreSQL                                                                                                                                                               | SQLite                                                                                                                                                                       | MySQL            |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| Value types                                                            | `vector.Vector` (`vector(n)`, 1 to 16000), `vector.HalfVector` (`halfvec`), `vector.SparseVector` (`sparsevec`), `vector.Bits` (`bit(n)`)                                | `vector.Vector` (float32 BLOB with a length CHECK, `SQLiteVectorType`) and `vector.Bits` (`SQLiteBitsType`); `vector.HalfVector` and `vector.SparseVector`: `ErrUnsupported` | no               |
| Dimensionless columns                                                  | `vector`, `halfvec` without `dim`: any size, filter by a dims column; no ANN index (refused)                                                                             | not tested on SQLite; `SQLiteVectorType` needs a dimension for its length CHECK (`ErrUnsupported` for zero)                                                                  | no               |
| Metrics (builders)                                                     | `vecop.L2` `<->`, `vecop.InnerProduct` `<#>`, `vecop.Cosine` `<=>`, `vecop.L1` `<+>`, `vecop.Hamming` `<~>`, `vecop.Jaccard` `<%>`; hamming and jaccard take bit columns | l2 `vec_distance_l2`, l1, cosine, hamming (bit columns, `vec_bit`); inner product and jaccard: `ErrUnsupported`                                                              | no               |
| ANN indexes                                                            | `hnsw`, `ivfflat`; limits and opclasses in vectors.md; `ivfflat` does not support sparsevec                                                                              | none: brute force; the dialect lists no index method                                                                                                                         | no               |
| Search settings                                                        | `vecsearch.Settings`, `vecsearch.With`, `vecsearch.Apply`, `Tx.SetLocal`; transaction scoped                                                                             | `ExactSearch` is a no-op (every search is exact); any other field: `ErrUnsupported`                                                                                          | `ErrUnsupported` |
| Iterative scan, `max_scan_tuples`, `scan_mem_multiplier`, `max_probes` | yes, pgvector 0.8.0 or newer (else `ErrUnsupported`)                                                                                                                     | no                                                                                                                                                                           | no               |
| Exact search                                                           | `vecsearch.Settings.ExactSearch`                                                                                                                                         | always: sqlite-vec compares every row                                                                                                                                        | no               |
| Binary wire codec                                                      | opt-in: `pgxdriver.ConfigureVectors`, `WithVectorFormat(VectorBinary)`                                                                                                   | no                                                                                                                                                                           | no               |
| Plan inspection                                                        | `SelectQuery.Explain`                                                                                                                                                    | SQLite: not verified (no test)                                                                                                                                               | `ErrUnsupported` |
| Full-text search (`tsvector`, `@@`, rank, headline), see fulltext.md   | yes, package `fts` (`fts.Match`, `fts.Rank`, `fts.Headline`) and `types.TSVector`                                                                                        | no                                                                                                                                                                           | `ErrUnsupported` |
| Hybrid search (full text plus vector, RRF)                             | yes, `momo.HybridSearch` (cosine distance, reciprocal rank fusion)                                                                                                       | no                                                                                                                                                                           | no               |

## Migrations

The `momo migrate` command selects the PostgreSQL dialect (see the generated
status above for the library dialects). `diff`, `validate` (without `--db`) and
`hash` run offline; the other commands need a database. Run `momo migrate` over
a direct PostgreSQL connection, not a transaction-mode pooler: the migration lock is a
session advisory lock.

| Feature                       | PostgreSQL                                                                                                                                                                                                            | CLI / API                                                                               |
| ----------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Diff models to SQL (offline)  | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `momo migrate diff <name>`; `migrate.Diff`                                              |
| Rename hints                  | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `--rename-table a=b`, `--rename-column t.a=b`                                           |
| Destructive change guard      | yes; `diff` refuses without `--allow-destructive`; `apply` does not check                                                                                                                                             | directive `-- momo:destructive`                                                         |
| Apply                         | yes, forward only; `--to N`, `--lock-wait`                                                                                                                                                                            | `momo migrate apply`; `migrate.Engine.Apply`                                            |
| Pending list                  | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `momo migrate plan`; `migrate.Engine.Plan`                                              |
| Status per version            | yes; states `pending`, `applied`, `dirty`, `mismatch`, `missing`                                                                                                                                                      | `momo migrate status`; `migrate.Engine.Status`                                          |
| Concurrent index              | yes; `Concurrently()` makes `migrate diff` write `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY` in its own `-- momo:no-transaction` migration, split from transactional DDL; a failed build leaves an invalid index that `drift` reports | `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY`                                                             |
| Transactional DDL             | yes; a migration runs in a transaction unless it carries `-- momo:no-transaction`                                                                                                                                     |                                                                                         |
| Migration lock                | session advisory lock; `--lock-wait` bounds the wait; a held advisory lock cannot be forced and there is no `--force-unlock`: it is freed when its holder disconnects (end the session with `pg_terminate_backend`)   |                                                                                         |
| Checksums                     | yes, file `momo.sum`                                                                                                                                                                                                  | `momo migrate hash`, `rehash`, `validate`; `migrate.ErrChecksumMismatch`                |
| Validate                      | yes, offline or with `--db`                                                                                                                                                                                           | `momo migrate validate [--db]`                                                          |
| Drift detection               | yes: `Changed`, `Missing`, `Unmanaged`; view, trigger and policy text is compared with CREATE on the database, else listed as `Unverified`; `--strict` makes that an error                                            | `momo migrate drift [--strict]`; `migrate.Engine.Drift`, `migrate.Engine.DriftWith`     |
| Baseline an existing database | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `momo migrate baseline --version N [--force]`                                           |
| Settle a dirty migration      | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `momo migrate resolve --version N --applied` or `--rolled-back`                         |
| Additive auto-migrate         | yes; never drops or alters types; skipped changes are reported                                                                                                                                                        | `migrate.Engine.AutoMigrate`                                                            |
| Rollback                      | yes, `momo migrate rollback [--group]` runs hand-written `.down.sql` files (`migrate.ErrNoDown` when one is missing); `resolve --rolled-back` only records that you undid a dirty migration by hand and runs no SQL   | `momo migrate rollback`; `migrate.Engine.Rollback`, `migrate.RollbackOptions`           |
| Rebase                        | yes, `momo migrate rebase --onto <dir> [name]` regenerates this branch's generated migrations on top of the target branch's directory                                                                                 | `momo migrate rebase`; `migrate.Engine.Rebase`                                          |
| Lint                          | yes, `momo migrate lint [--db]` reports risky operations with severity and a safer alternative; exits 1 on an error                                                                                                   | `momo migrate lint`; `migrate.Engine.Lint`, `migrate.Engine.LintAll`, `migrate.LintSQL` |
| Custom migration              | yes, `momo migrate new --custom <name>` writes an empty hand-written migration                                                                                                                                        | `momo migrate new --custom`; `migrate.Engine.NewCustom`                                 |

## Generator and CLI

| Item                          | Status                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| ----------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `momo generate`               | yes; flags `-c momo.yaml`, `--check` (exit 1 when generated files are stale); `--from-db` writes models and the init snapshot from a PostgreSQL database                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Generated output              | typed column descriptors, `Meta`, relation descriptors, permission-typed columns (`read_only`, `create_only`, `immutable`), vector columns                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Custom generator plugins      | Built-in: `graphql`, `grpc`, `openapi` and `viz`, enabled and configured in the `plugins:` section of `momo.yaml`; your own plugins come from a binary built with `cli.Main(plugins...)`, or from `gen.Emit`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Ecosystem generators          | GraphQL (gqlgen), gRPC (protoc with a field-number lock) and OpenAPI 3.1 (optional `net/http` handlers) servers over the typed API; filters go through the generated `ColumnByName` allowlist and pages use keyset cursors                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Generated servers: access     | Generated handlers, gRPC services and GraphQL resolvers do no authentication or authorization; wrap the mux, the grpc.Server or the handler. `ops: [list, get]` (all models) or `ops: {Model: [...], "*": [...]}` and `read_only: true` choose the operations of `openapi` and `grpc`; the default serves all five                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Generated servers: views      | A model that embeds `momo.View` is read-only in `openapi` and `grpc`: only list and get are served, whatever `ops` says for `*`; naming a write operation for the view model itself is a generator diagnostic. GraphQL serves queries only                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Generated servers: errors     | Fixed messages, no table or constraint names: not found 404 / NotFound, unique 409 / AlreadyExists, foreign key 409 / FailedPrecondition, check and not-null 400 / InvalidArgument, busy or serialization failure 503 / Unavailable; a cancelled request 499 / Canceled / `CANCELED`, a passed deadline 504 / DeadlineExceeded / `CANCELED`; GraphQL sends the same through an error presenter                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Generated servers: error hook | The `openapi` and `grpc` options `on_error: OnError` call `OnError(ctx, op, err)`, a function of the generated package, once for every error a handler or call answers, with the operation (`getDocument`, `DocumentService.Get`) and the original error, before the fixed message is written; the generated code compiles without it; `openapi` needs `handlers: true` for it (a diagnostic otherwise), and a panic in the hook is recovered                                                                                                                        |
| OpenAPI schemas               | `<Model>` is the output (every column, not-null columns including the key in `required`); `<Model>Input` is what create and PUT take (writable properties only, no key or read-only column). The gRPC message is one for both directions; its field comments say which fields a request ignores                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Generated servers: writes     | A key that is not exactly a property name is a 400. OpenAPI create needs every required property (not null, no default, not a key, not read-only), else 400; PUT needs the same and only the properties it carries are written, in one statement that reads nothing first; bodies are application/json (415), at most 1 MiB (413), one object. gRPC Update writes every writable column in one statement without reading the row first; a proto3 scalar cannot be absent, so a defaulted scalar at its zero value keeps its stored value                             |
| GraphQL limits                | `model.NewHandler` limits the request body to 1 MiB, the depth to 8 (an introspection query is exempt) and the complexity to 500 (`NewHandlerWithLimits` changes them), and refuses a request whose selected relations could load more than 10000 rows (page size times 100 per to-many level, counted level by level); `in` lists hold at most 100 values, filters nest at most 4 deep with at most 20 terms per list, and a to-many relation returns at most 100 rows per parent (the first by primary key); relations are preloaded to the depth of the selection |
| gRPC field numbers            | The lock records each field's type and cardinality: a change retires the old number into `reserved` and assigns a new one; messages are keyed by table, so renaming a Go type keeps its numbers                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| `momo migrate`                | `diff`, `new --custom`, `plan`, `apply`, `status`, `validate`, `hash`, `rehash`, `baseline`, `drift`, `resolve`, `lint`, `rollback`, `rebase`; flags `--dir` (migration directory, overrides `migrate.dir`) and, on `diff`, `--stage` (stage NOT NULL columns without a default) and `--enforce-not-null` (emit SET NOT NULL after the backfill, see [migrations.md](migrations.md#not-null-columns))                                                                                                                                                                |
| `momo help [command]`         | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Exit codes                    | 0 success; 1 findings (stale files, drift, validation problems, refusals); 2 usage or configuration error; 3 database, lock or execution error (`migrate` only)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Database URL                  | `--url` (warns; `--url -` reads stdin), else `migrate.url_env.<dialect>` in `momo.yaml`, else `MOMO_DATABASE_URL`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Dialect selection             | `--dialect`, else the only configured dialect, else `postgres`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |

## Hooks and events

| Feature                                    | PostgreSQL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | API                                                                                                                                           |
| ------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Query hook                                 | yes; runs synchronously and must be safe for concurrent use; `BeforeQuery` may return a derived context                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `Hook`, `QueryEvent` (pool wait, in-transaction, argument count, dialect), `WithHook`                                                         |
| Argument logging                           | opt-in                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `WithArgLogging`                                                                                                                              |
| Relation hook                              | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `RelationHook`, `RelationEvent`                                                                                                               |
| Field hooks (Go-side defaults, validators) | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `FieldHook[T]`, `WithFieldHooks`                                                                                                              |
| Client-generated ids (cuid, uuid, ulid)    | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | tag `idgen:<name>`, `Config.IDGen`, `WithIDGenerator`, `Meta.IDGens`                                                                          |
| Pool wait tracing                          | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `pgxdriver.InstrumentPool(cfg)`, `momo.RecordPoolWait`                                                                                        |
| Injected clock                             | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `WithClock`                                                                                                                                   |
| slog hook                                  | yes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `momolog.New` with `momolog.Level`, `momolog.SlowOver`, `momolog.Values`; values logged only with `momolog.Values(true)` and `WithArgLogging` |
| OpenTelemetry hook                         | no such package in the repository                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | implement `Hook`                                                                                                                              |
| N+1 detector (development)                 | yes; counts statement shapes per scope, reports once past the threshold; at most 1024 shapes per scope; a panic in the report function is recovered                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `WithQueryScope`, `NewNPlusOneHook`                                                                                                           |
| Tenant filter                              | application-side convenience, NOT a security boundary; a missing or mistyped tenant fails the build with `ErrValidation`; not applied automatically to Update, Delete, Insert, Preload, Load, LoadCounts, joins, subqueries or raw SQL; reads its tenant only from `WithTenant`; row-level security is configured by your own `WithTxSetup` function (call `SetConfigLocal` there with the tenant), and without `WithImplicitTx` non-transactional queries get no setting | `WithTenant`, `TenantFilter`                                                                                                                  |

### Secrets in errors, hooks and connections

- Argument masking: with `WithArgLogging`, a value bound from a column tagged `sensitive` reaches hooks as `momo.RedactedArg`, not the value. This covers insert values, `Set` and `SetExpr` assignments on insert, update and upsert (every argument inside an expression assigned to a sensitive column), the primary-key and version predicates of a model update or delete, keyset `After` values, and WHERE predicates in which a sensitive column is one operand: the comparison methods, `EqExpr` and the other expression comparisons, `In`, `NotIn`, `Between`, `Like`, `ILike`, `ContainsLiteral`, `arrayop.Contains`, `arrayop.ContainedBy`, `arrayop.Overlaps`, `arrayop.AnyOf`, and the same methods on an expression that reads a sensitive column such as `sqlfn.Lower` of it. Relation loading, `Link`, `Unlink`, `Replace` and `Count` mask key values bound to sensitive key columns, including join-table columns that map to them. The database still receives the real value. `QueryEvent.Args` is always a copy, so a hook cannot replace or reorder the bound arguments. The copy is deep for `[]byte` and `json.RawMessage` values only, so changing those in place does not reach the driver; other mutable argument types are shared. Known gaps: arguments passed to raw `momo.SQL` or `momo.TypedSQL` fragments are not masked, because Momo cannot tell which column they belong to; SQLite renders values in an ON CONFLICT target predicate as SQL literals, so such a value appears in `QueryEvent.SQL`. Do not enable argument logging where raw fragments or conflict-target predicates carry secrets. `Error.Detail()` is also unmasked: it returns the raw driver detail, which for a PostgreSQL constraint violation quotes the offending key values, including sensitive ones. Do not log it or return it to clients; `Error()` is the safe text.
- Encode errors: the pgx driver withholds the text of pgx client-side encode failures, which quote the bound value, on every path (pool, transactions, pinned and adopted connections, the database/sql adapter, rows). The message keeps the argument position, such as `args[2]`; the original error stays reachable with `errors.Is`, `errors.As` and `Unwrap`. That unwrapped cause still contains the bound value, so code that logs every link of an error chain must not print the causes.
- Simple protocol: `pgxdriver.WithExecMode`, `FromConnConfig` and `FromSQLDB` refuse simple protocol, which interpolates values client-side, with `ErrUnsupported`. `FromConnConfig` checks the config it is given. `FromSQLDB` cannot read the pgx config of an opaque `*sql.DB`, so it checks the first connection it uses, on the first statement, not at construction. Only that first connection is checked: a custom connector that varies the exec mode per connection is not checked.

## Multi-tenant row-level security

Row-level security (RLS) policies usually read a setting such as
`current_setting('app.tenant_id', true)`. The fail-closed pattern sets that
setting at the start of every transaction from a scope carried in the
`context.Context`, so a statement that forgot its scope matches no rows.
`WithTxSetup` and `WithImplicitTx` build that into the `*DB`:

<!-- docscheck:fragment -->

```go
db := momo.New(pgxdriver.New(pool),
	momo.WithTxSetup(func(ctx context.Context, tx *momo.Tx) error {
		id, ok := tenantFrom(ctx)
		if !ok {
			return nil // no scope: nothing is set, the policy matches no rows
		}
		return momo.SetConfigLocal(ctx, tx, "app.tenant_id", id)
	}),
	momo.WithImplicitTx(),
)
```

```sql
ALTER TABLE documents ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
ALTER TABLE documents FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON documents
  USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::bigint)
  WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.tenant_id', true), '')::bigint);
```

Connect as a role without `BYPASSRLS` that does not own the tables (or use
`FORCE`, as above): superusers and `BYPASSRLS` roles skip every policy.

| Feature                       | Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ----------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `WithTxSetup`                 | The function runs right after every transaction momo begins: `DB.Begin`, `DB.Tx`, and the transactions momo opens itself (chunked inserts, graph creation, relation writes, `vecsearch.With`, implicit transactions). It runs once per real transaction, not per savepoint, and not for `AdoptTx` (the caller began that transaction). An error rolls back and is returned.                                                                                   |
| `WithImplicitTx`              | Auto-commit statements on a `*DB` (`Select`, `Insert`, `Update`, `Delete`, `Exec`, `Scalars`, relation loads) each run in a short transaction, so the setup applies. `Iter`, `Each` and `Rows` hold the transaction until exhausted or closed, then commit; a scan or driver error rolls back, and so does a cancelled context for a write or a read abandoned early (a fully drained read still commits). Close early-abandoned rows to free the connection. |
| `SetConfigLocal`              | `set_config(key, value, true)`: the setting ends with the transaction. The same as `Tx.SetLocal`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Not used on an implicit `*DB` | Pipelined relation loading (`Batch`) and the raw driver `COPY` path, because they bypass the setup (`InsertQuery[T].Copy` instead runs in its own transaction). `BatcherOf` and `CopierOf` report none for such a `*DB`; use a `Tx` for them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

A behaviour change for `WithImplicitTx` on an unpinned `*DB` only: the rows of
an `Insert`, `Update` or `Delete` with RETURNING (`Rows`) must be read to the
end before `Close`. A write closed unread, or after reading only the first row
(for example `UpdateQuery.Rows` or `DeleteQuery.Rows` users who read one row and
close), is rolled back and `Close` returns `ErrValidation`; this includes a
panic that unwinds through the loop. Handles without `WithImplicitTx`, a `Tx`
and a pinned `OnConn` handle are unaffected, and `FindOrCreate`, `UpsertByPK`
and `CreateGraph` read to the end themselves.

Without `WithImplicitTx`, auto-commit statements on a `*DB` run outside any
transaction, so the setup never applies to them and they are unscoped. Use
`WithImplicitTx` (or `DB.Tx`) whenever the setup enforces a security boundary.
Statements run through `db.Driver()` bypass momo and its hooks entirely, so
they are never scoped either.

The setup does not cover everything. `AdoptTx` transactions are the caller's,
so apply the setting yourself. `momo migrate` and Go migrations run outside the
`*DB` options, so they are never scoped; run them as a role that may bypass
the policies. A handle from `OnConn` cannot begin a transaction, so on a `*DB`
configured with `WithTxSetup` its statements fail with `ErrUnsupported`
instead of running unscoped, and it reports no COPY or Batch path. A panic in
a setup function rolls the transaction back before it propagates, and a panic
in an `Each` or `Iter` callback rolls back the implicit transaction. If the
context is cancelled before a streaming implicit write is closed, the write is
rolled back and `Close` and `Err` return the context error.

Behind PgBouncer in transaction mode use only transaction-local settings
(`SetConfigLocal`), never a session-level `SET`: the session belongs to
whichever client PgBouncer hands the backend to next. `TestImplicitTxPgBouncer`
runs concurrent tenants through PgBouncer and checks no scope leaks.

## PgBouncer and TLS

| Feature                        | PostgreSQL                                                                      | Notes                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| PgBouncer, transaction pooling | yes, with the default exec mode                                                 | The default `pgx.QueryExecModeExec` sends unnamed statements and binds server-side. `TestPgBouncerNoNamedPreparedStatements` checks on the wire that no named prepared statement is created. `WithExecMode` also accepts `CacheStatement`, `CacheDescribe`, `DescribeExec`; the simple protocol is rejected with `ErrUnsupported`. Do not run `momo migrate` through a transaction pooler. A `search_path` set at connection start does not reliably survive pooling; `vecsearch.Settings` and `Tx.SetLocal` use transaction-local `set_config`, which does. |
| TLS                            | yes, as configured by the pgx connection string (`sslmode`, `sslrootcert`, ...) | `NewPool(ctx, url)` hands the URL to pgx. Momo adds no TLS options. `momo migrate` prints a TLS warning when the URL has `sslmode=disable` and a non-loopback host. Use `sslmode=verify-full` for remote databases.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## What returns `ErrUnsupported`

All match `errors.Is(err, momo.ErrUnsupported)`. Build-time errors surface from
`SQL()` or at first execution.

| Call                                                          | When                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `momo migrate` on SQLite or MySQL                             | The CLI builds only the PostgreSQL dialect, so `momo migrate` exits 2 on both (use the library dialects `migrate/sqlite` and `migrate/mysql`)                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `Upsert`, `OnConflict`, `FindOrCreate`                        | `Upsert`, `OnConflict`: a dialect with neither `ON CONFLICT` nor `ON DUPLICATE KEY`; on MySQL also a target that is not the only unique key, and a `Where` on the conflict clause. `FindOrCreate`: a dialect without `ON CONFLICT` and `RETURNING`, which is MySQL and MariaDB                                             |
| `CreateGraph`                                                 | `*Tx` on a dialect without savepoints; dialect without `RETURNING` (rejected before the transaction opens)                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| `ForUpdate`, `ForShare`                                       | dialect without row locks (SQLite metadata)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `IndexedBy`                                                   | PostgreSQL and MySQL                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| `After`                                                       | a nullable `OrderBy` key                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| `SetDefault`, multi-row insert with default in some rows      | dialect without `DEFAULT` support for that shape                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `db.Begin`, `db.Tx`, `Replace`, `CreateGraph`, chunked insert | `*DB` pinned with `OnConn` (Op "begin"; chunked insert: Op "insert"); unknown `Querier`; isolation level outside the four standard ones                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `Tx.Savepoint`                                                | dialect without savepoints (Op "savepoint")                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `Each`, `Iter`                                                | the query has `Preload`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| `Joined()`                                                    | not belongs-to, child key not unique, `GroupBy`, `Having`, row locks, `Each`, `Iter`, or combined with `Load`, `LoadAll`, `Scope`, `Then`                                                                                                                                                                                  |
